$schema-comment: The asset set each release must carry (09 Release assets / release.yml step 1). verify-tag.sh expands {v} with the version and {mac_ext} with mac_kind (macos-arm64.zip before 1.0.0, .dmg from it, D63/PO-39). publish fails when the uploaded set differs — the 'always' files are generated in publish itself. Groups join the verify-tag --products list as their release jobs land.

milestones.comment: the milestone a group starts shipping; verify-tag.sh --products names the active groups (M0a: android). {jdk}, {wix}, {ffmpeg} and {pbsTag} come from the lockfiles when those groups join.
